scope: Personal/local Markdown technical notes; simulated saved questions, not production or independent human review.
control: Same-session current implementation, fresh isolated collections, unchanged models and corpus hashes.
hypotheses: Overlapping chunks drop acknowledgement-mode qualifiers. Bounded complete section context should restore them.
Leaf headings lose parent subjects. An independently measured heading-ancestry candidate should improve comparison retrieval.
Answer instructions or layout cause omissions and neighboring citations even when correct evidence is admitted. Only test after source-context candidates.
first_candidate: For split recursive sections of at most twice chunk_size, retain the entire normalized section as window_text; keep central text, headings, source location, embeddings and sparse inputs unchanged.

guards.context_bound: Window text <= 2 * chunk_size runes; long sections keep existing bounded chunk text.
guards.retrieval: 133-query golden set, 3 runs; Hit@5, MRR@10 and nDCG@5 no worse by more than 0.01; compare central-text-only matching too, because expanded windows can enlarge annotated evidence.
guards.generation: Rerun all 40 unchanged questions; do not accept a candidate that merely fixes one case while adding material failures elsewhere. Local targets remain 27/30 supported, 5/5 unsupported and 5/5 follow-ups.
guards.broader: Check representative 64-query pack and directly inspect changed cases before accepting quality-affecting changes.

second_candidate.change: Preserve heading ancestry separately from the leaf header, use it in embeddings/BM25 and citation labels, and carry it through stored and cached retrieval results. Bounded section windows remain the first candidate baseline.
second_candidate.guard: Keep source text, source lines, deterministic IDs and exact leaf-header filtering intact; full reindex is required. Apply the same golden/representative no-regression bars.

scoped_heading_candidate.reason: All-ancestor indexing improved primary ranking but lost ride-s2-neighbors on the broader pack (Hit@5 -0.0179), failing the 0.01 guard.
scoped_heading_candidate.change: Use ancestry in embedding/BM25 only for repeated leaf headings; keep unique leaf indexing inputs unchanged. Preserve full ancestry for source labels.
scoped_heading_candidate.guards: Same pre-registered golden and representative bars; no fixture edits.

app_prompt_candidate.change: Scoped heading ancestry and bounded section windows plus retrieval-order source presentation and one general intent-completeness instruction. Keep generator/rewriter models and all configuration defaults unchanged.
app_prompt_candidate.rejected: All-ancestor indexing, duplicate removal, XML source wrappers, question-first prompts, stronger scope reminders and alternative model/rewrite changes either regressed examples or did not resolve the conditional failure. Identical temperature-zero prompts sometimes yield different text; single lucky completions are not acceptance evidence.
app_prompt_candidate.validation: Run unchanged daily 40 and broader representative 64 through the real app; directly review questions, answers and supporting cited text. Record outstanding failures honestly; do not claim the local finish line if follow-ups remain below 5/5.

bounded_prompt_candidate.reason: The first app prompt candidate fixed five primary failures but added a wrong 30-degree citation and an unmapped source footnote on the broader pack; stronger output scope is needed.
bounded_prompt_candidate.change: Restore the concise-answer instruction alongside completeness; explicitly distinguish source footnotes from app context IDs and illustrative values from actual system values. Extend the existing live-observation guard for owned current/latest state and explicit official/actual production measurements for today.
bounded_prompt_candidate.guard: Retain unchanged queries, annotations, models and corpus; rerun all 104 app questions and inspect material citations, with direct broad comparison to the control.

label_scope_candidate.hypothesis: A short bold label occupying the first source line of a paragraph introduces an evidence scope. Flattening Auto and Manual acknowledgement into one section makes repeated windows mix contradictory modes; preserving label scopes should retain their subject and separate the warnings.
label_scope_candidate.change: Split at short leading standalone bold labels; keep conventional Markdown leaf header filters intact, include the label in section ancestry and original evidence text, and preserve source anchors. Retain bounded section windows and repeated-heading qualification; restore the original concise grounding instructions to isolate the source fix. Keep new current/today live-state guard coverage.
label_scope_candidate.guards: Same fixed-corpus golden and representative retrieval no-regression bars plus full 104-question app review. No changes to questions, answers or sample source text.

scoped_label_candidate.reason: The first label candidate repeated ancestry for every label under a unique heading and lost ride-s2-neighbors (broader Hit@5 -0.0179). Its conditional acknowledgement answer still failed.
scoped_label_candidate.change: Count distinct conventional heading paths when qualifying repeated leaf headings. A label under a unique heading contributes only leaf > label to indexing, with full ancestry retained for citations. Keep original concise prompt and add one instruction to name each alternative in comparisons, avoiding fragment-only answers. Retain retrieval-order presentation and expanded live-state guard.
scoped_label_candidate.guard: Same fixed-corpus retrieval bars and complete 104-question review; acknowledgement follow-up remains required and explicitly open.

query_focus_candidate.reason: The comparison prompt instruction introduced a false 404 answer and did not meet the semantic guard; remove it. Hybrid BM25 currently includes common English question words, repeatedly promoting unrelated context-switching chunks. Unchanged conditional rewrites omit the selected subject/mode from retrieval.
query_focus_candidate.change: Filter question/function words in the hybrid sparse query only; preserve negation, numbers, document vectors, literal keyword lookup and native Qdrant RRF. Add bounded prior answer context to unchanged unresolved ordinal/conditional rewrites while preserving named standalone subjects. Keep source-scope fixes and original concise generation instructions.
query_focus_candidate.guard: Measure fixed golden and representative retrieval over three runs and full 104 app questions; no model or fusion/reranker configuration changes.

complete_answer_candidate.reason: Query focus fixes the polling cause, order partition-key action and backpressure citation, but the short-answer instruction still yields incomplete graph, manifest and storage-tier answers. Source-local numeric footnotes can be copied as unmapped app citation numbers when the answer expands.
complete_answer_candidate.change: Use one complete-and-concise answer instruction, retaining the original grounding and question-shaping clauses. In presented evidence, label numeric Markdown footnote references as document notes rather than bracketed app IDs; preserve stored chunks, source hashes, values such as [7], and exact admitted snapshots. No source corpus edits.
complete_answer_candidate.guard: Re-run all 104 saved app questions against unchanged retrieval; review new and old failures directly; do not claim the local finish line unless all acceptance groups pass.

retained_candidate.change: Retain source scopes/windows, qualified repeated headings, query-only sparse filtering, retrieval-order presentation and bounded reference fallback. Restore original concise generation instructions. Present numeric source footnote markers without source-local numbers; stored source and bracketed values remain unchanged.
retained_candidate.reason: Completeness prompt produced a reversed convergence comparison, wrong degree citation and unmapped footnote in the broader pack. Reject it despite 28/30 primary supported answers.
retained_candidate.validation: Complete unchanged 40+64 app packs; review every answer and cited evidence against same-session control. Run three app repetitions of fragile primary cases plus convergence, trigonometric citation and coalescing cases; record variability, no cherry-picking. The local finish line remains open unless all groups pass.

prefix_boundary_candidate.bug: embedFragments mutates its caller-owned fragment slice by adding the embedding query task prefix; multiSearch then sends those same prefixed strings to hybrid lexical search and optional fusion scoring. The default prefix adds task/search/result/query tokens to every query.
prefix_boundary_candidate.change: Allocate prefixed embedding inputs separately and retain raw fragments for lexical search and fusion. Dense embeddings, source chunks, models and generation instructions stay unchanged. Query-time fix; no reindex required. New isolated cache and history collections for measurement.
prefix_boundary_candidate.verification: The existing fragment/batching integration test now records the hybrid inputs and fails on prefixed search terms before the fix. Reuse it to check the raw original query and both fragments while keeping prefixed embedding inputs.
prefix_boundary_candidate.guards: Same golden 133 and broader 64 retrieval queries, 3 runs; full 104 unchanged app questions and direct semantic review; no material new failures relative to the fresh control; repeat fragile follow-ups. Local acceptance remains 27/30, 5/5, 5/5.

installed_model_app_candidate.change: Measure already-installed llama3.1:8b-instruct-q4_K_M for both generation and rewriting through the unchanged API implementation and corrected prefix boundary. Same 4096 generation context, 512 output, temperature zero, corpus/chunks and native RRF; new isolated history/cache collections. No download or default configuration change.
installed_model_app_candidate.reason: Captured cleaner-context probes improved manifest completeness, named convergence comparison, structural/causal alternatives and private-IP decline, but did not resolve captured Manual follow-up or all citations. Real app measurement is required because seed answers and rewriting from this model differ from replayed Gemma history.
installed_model_app_candidate.guards: Same local 27/30, 5/5, 5/5 and full 104-question semantic no-regression comparison to control. Capture serving config/model hashes and actual residence/memory. Do not adopt on the basis of replay probes or one lucky conditional.

cpu_embedding_model_candidate.change: Same installed 8B generator/rewriter and corrected prefix code, with the small embedding model explicitly on CPU using a disposable localhost-only options proxy (num_gpu=0). No production code/default changes; new isolated history/cache. Pin generator 4096/512 and keep request timeouts.
cpu_embedding_model_candidate.reason: GPU-default 8B app run stopped at 24 captured cases after repeated roughly 9–18 second first-token times, with only the 8B runner resident. A separate CPU-placement comparison tests whether generation and embedding can remain resident concurrently on existing hardware.
cpu_embedding_model_candidate.guards: Verify readiness, CPU embedder size_vram=0, coexistence and actual latency. Re-run unchanged retrieval packs 3 times because device numerics can affect ranks. Re-run all 104 app questions and semantic no-regression checks; local 27/30, 5/5, 5/5 unchanged. Partial earlier model run is diagnostic only.

cpu_placement_direct_wiring.change: Replace the disposable embedding-options proxy with the existing Ollama provider option and optional embedder.num_gpu / EMBEDDER_NUM_GPU config. Default remains unset. Same installed 8B model experiment; no default model adoption.
cpu_placement_direct_wiring.validation: HTTP payload tests and config validation with race checks; all Go unit tests, vet and evaluator build. Run the pre-selected 13-case fragile subset through the new binary with num_gpu=0, capture served binary/config/source hashes and resident models. This is wiring smoke evidence, not a replacement for the full 104-case proxy comparison or semantic acceptance.
